title: Tracepod removal manifest (schema v1)
description: The removed-set the hardener writes to <output-dir>/removal-manifest.json on every successful harden. One document per hardened build. It lists every OS package present in the source image and entirely absent from the hardened image, with the source-image file paths that drove each removal. This is the OSS-3 producer for the WP3 removal-VEX contract: the controller consumes it to emit component_not_present attestations for the hardened image without re-scanning it. Facts only — no reachability, runtime, justification, or VEX vocabulary. CVE association is the controller's concern. The consumed subset (the fields the controller deserialises) is schema, schema_version, source_digest, hardened_digest, hardened_ref, removed; source_platform and tooling are additive audit metadata. See docs/removal-manifest-schema/README.md for the versioning policy and field semantics.

schema.description: Contract identity shared with the controller (WP3). Always this constant for documents matching this schema.

schema_version.description: Removal-manifest schema version. Always the string "1.0" for documents matching this schema. A shape change bumps this in lockstep with a new docs/removal-manifest-schema file.

source_digest.description: OCI manifest digest (sha256:...) of the source image the build consumed. The package view and the file view are both derived from this exact digest.

source_platform.description: Platform of the source image scan, e.g. "linux/arm64". Additive audit metadata; per-package architecture is also encoded in each purl qualifier.

hardened_digest.description: OCI manifest digest (sha256:...) of the hardened image. Product identity for the consumer's attestations.

hardened_ref.description: repo[:tag]@digest of the hardened image (the push target when pushed, else the layout ref), pinned to hardened_digest.

tooling.description: Versions of the tools that produced the removed-set. Additive audit metadata; not part of the consumed subset.

syft.description: Syft version that cataloged the source packages, taken from the syft-json descriptor.

removed.description: Packages present in the source image and entirely absent from the hardened image. A package with ANY retained file is NOT listed (partial retention is not removal). Empty array when nothing was removed.

purl.description: package-url of the removed package, taken verbatim from the source SBOM (syft).

paths.description: Source-image absolute paths owned by this package whose absence in the hardened image is the evidence of removal. Sorted and de-duplicated. Never a runtime claim.
